faq.question: What is the best seafood restaurant in Hua Hin?
faq.answer: Ko Mark Restaurant (★4.7, 2,567 reviews) is the highest-rated seafood restaurant in the Hua Hin area on Google. For the most iconic pier-side experience, Chaolay Seafood on Soi Naresdamri has been serving fresh catches for decades. For a local-only experience, Chomview Seafood near Cha-am is the Reddit community's top recommendation.

faq.question: How much does seafood cost in Hua Hin?
faq.answer: Seafood in Hua Hin ranges from very affordable to upscale. At local spots like Jek Pia, a bowl of seafood noodles costs ฿50–฿200 (under $6). Mid-range restaurants like Chaolay and Ketsarin serve full seafood meals for ฿200–฿600 ($6–$17) per person. Upscale options like Big Fish & Bar and Sea Fire Salt range from ฿500–฿2,500 ($15–$70).

faq.question: Where do locals eat seafood in Hua Hin?
faq.answer: Locals favor Chomview Seafood (near Cha-am), Sungwean Seafood, and Jek Pia for authentic, affordable seafood. These spots have minimal foreign tourists and no English menus. The Naresdamri pier area (Chaolay, Ketsarin) is also popular with locals, though it draws more tourists. Redditors specifically recommend Chomview as the #1 local pick.

faq.question: Is Hua Hin good for seafood?
faq.answer: Hua Hin is one of Thailand's best destinations for seafood. As a historic fishing town on the Gulf of Thailand, it has direct access to fresh catches daily. The seafood scene ranges from humble noodle shops and night market grills to oceanfront fine dining. Prices are significantly lower than Bangkok or Phuket for comparable quality.

faq.question: What seafood should I try in Hua Hin?
faq.answer: Must-try dishes include: steamed whole fish with lime and garlic, garlic prawns, crab fried rice, stir-fried crab with curry powder, tom yum goong (spicy prawn soup), grilled squid, and fish ball noodle soup at Jek Pia. Most restaurants let you pick your own live seafood and choose the cooking style.

faq.question: When is the best time to eat seafood in Hua Hin?
faq.answer: For the freshest catches, visit the morning market or eat at Jek Pia (opens 6 AM). Most seafood restaurants serve lunch and dinner, with sunset (5–7 PM) being the most popular time for beachfront dining. The night market (from 5 PM) is great for casual grilled seafood. Weekdays are less crowded than weekends.

methodology: We analyzed 50+ Reddit posts and comments across r/HuaHin, r/Thailand, and r/ThailandTourism, cross-referenced with TripAdvisor rankings and Google Maps ratings. Restaurants were ranked by a combination of Google rating, review volume, Reddit mention frequency, and authentic local recommendations. Every spot was verified with current Google Places data in March 2026.
